title: Plans and limits

description.platform: One catalog of every limit: the default without a plan, the platform ceiling and the value of each plan on sale.
description.partner: The limits of the plans you can sell to your customers. The platform sets them.

core_seats.label: Company seats
core_seats.description: Active members and pending invitations of the company.

core_public_domains.label: Public domains of the workspace
core_public_domains.description: Own domains of the website, digital profile and quiz. Without a plan value, none.

core_upload_mb.label: Maximum upload size
core_upload_mb.description: Largest file accepted in one upload.

core_api_requests_per_minute.label: API calls per minute
core_api_requests_per_minute.description: Per-workspace limit of the API and MCP; today it comes from the environment.

core_ai_turns_per_month.label: AI replies per month
core_ai_turns_per_month.description: Monthly AI usage, beyond the number of agents.

catalog.title: Limits catalog
catalog.description: Each limit with the default for companies without a plan, the platform ceiling and the value of the current version of each active plan. Empty in a plan uses the default.
catalog.noPlans: No active plan with a published version.

ceilings.title: Platform ceilings
ceilings.description: No plan may go above the ceiling. Without a ceiling, a plan may say "unlimited". A ceiling never goes below a plan on sale.
ceilings.label: Ceiling: {quota}

planForm.title: {plan} · version {version}
planForm.description: Publishing creates version {next} with the same prices and modules. Subscriptions already open keep their version.

readOnly: Read only: ceilings and limits are changed by whoever manages the platform billing.

partner.note: Values of the current version of each plan. Empty uses the platform default.

actions.limitsPublished: Limits published in version {version} of the plan.

errors.invalidValue: {quota}: use a whole number from 0 to 1,000,000.
errors.aboveCeiling: {quota}: the value is above the platform ceiling ({ceiling}).
errors.unlimitedUnderCeiling: {quota}: "unlimited" does not fit the platform ceiling ({ceiling}).
errors.ceilingBelowPlan: {quota}: plan {plan} is on sale above this ceiling. Publish a version of the plan within it first.
errors.noVersion: The plan has no version yet: publish its values in Billing first.
